SUNLU manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C.
Manufacturer max speed 350 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 24.5 mm3/s (printer profile 17) from the manufacturer's 350 mm/s rating, capped at 24.5 for this printer.
Temperature set for ~250 mm/s on this printer: 270 C (first layer 270 C). Manufacturer bands: 260-280 C at 50-300 mm/s; 280-290 C at 300-350 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page: 260-280C @50-300, 280-290C @300-350mm/s; bed 90-100C. Wiki: fan OFF, ventilation; wiki drying value is 50C which looks like a template error (other ABS grades 80C) - treat with caution. Shore (HA/HD) 80; HDT 93C.
Source: https://www.sunlu.com/products/high-speed-abs-filament
